title: The Maze II
goal: Find the shortest rolling distance that stops exactly at the destination.
strategy: The ball cannot brake in a corridor. Each wall-to-wall roll is one weighted edge; Dijkstra settles stopping positions in increasing total distance. Passing over the target does not finish the journey.
